description.en: The resolution records. This parameter is valid only when Type is set to A.

description.zh:
内网域名解析的类型
- VPC：针对VPC授权解析，仅支持绑定传统类型专享实例；
- A：支持创建A记录，仅支持绑定VPC融合类型专享实例
description.en:
The internal domain name resolution type. Valid values:

*   VPC: resolution for virtual private cloud (VPC) access authorizations. A resolution of this type can be bound only to traditional dedicated instances.
*   A: resolution that supports A records. A resolution of this type can be bound only to VPC integration dedicated instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi update-private-dns --intranet-domain api.demo.com --type A --records Record=192.168.0.2 Weight=100 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
